deadline.value: Apply by April 1 for priority consideration.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to advise the student before admission.
supervisor.quote: Students are only admitted to our program if a faculty member has agreed to serve as the advisor.

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed; applicants must ask faculty about funding in their research area.
funding.quote: Funding is not guaranteed but an applicant can contact a faculty member in their research area to inquire about potential funding.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from a bachelor's to the PhD is rare; most applicants hold a master's.
entry_route.quote: Admission directly to the doctoral program from a bachelor’s degree program is rare, students are encouraged to start with the master’s program.

notes: The department does not offer application fee waivers; the university-wide waivers still apply.
